large_integer_precision.description: JSON integers outside serde_json's i64/u64 range are silently converted to floats, changing the stored value and the revision hash.
large_integer_precision.remove_when: issue #110 is fixed and the differential run is clean with large integers enabled

duplicate_key_order.description: Duplicate JSON object keys keep the last value but the wrong position, so the revision hash differs from CouchDB.
duplicate_key_order.remove_when: issue #123 is fixed and the duplicate-key cases pass
